A '''male Devaronian''' was a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] who wielded a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|saberstaff]], heir to the lineage of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] and the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of a [[Unidentified humanoid Sith Master|humanoid Sith Master]].
